title: Org Config (parsed)
description: Validates the flat dict produced by run_analysis.py::parse_markdown_kv over an org-config.md file, not the raw markdown text itself. Threshold keys follow the `{kpi}_green` / `{kpi}_yellow` convention (with cycle_time_p50 aliased to the `cycle_time_*` prefix — see run_analysis.py::THRESHOLD_PREFIX) and are constrained by patternProperties below. Whether active_patterns/disabled_patterns/team_overrides values are themselves valid pattern IDs or KPI IDs is checked against engine_defaults.json by the referential-integrity test, not by this schema — a JSON Schema file has no way to reference another file's data as an enum without duplicating it, which would itself violate D5's single-source-of-truth rule.

active_patterns.description: Restricts pattern detection/reporting to this set (run_analysis.py::detect_patterns). Must be a subset of engine_defaults.json's canonical pattern IDs.

team_overrides.description: Per-team threshold overrides, keyed by Team, each an object of the same `{kpi}_green`/`{kpi}_yellow` keys as the top level. Anticipated per the build spec (Sec.3.3) for the documented near-term team-level-thresholds requirement; not yet read by run_analysis.py — a forward-declared shape, not a currently-consumed one.

leading_indicator_thresholds.description: Per-indicator watch/concern thresholds (Sec.3.5.6) plus per-org applicability, keyed by indicator id in lowercase (e.g. 'missing_sp_ratio'). See maturity-engine/references/leading-indicator-rules.md and leading_indicators.py::evaluate_probabilistic_indicator / filter_applicable_indicators.

confidence_basis.description: Evidence strength for this indicator's threshold values, surfaced verbatim as the report's `basis` field when the indicator is evaluated.

applicable.description: Whether this indicator applies to this org's workflow at all. Defaults to true when omitted.

applicability_reason.description: Required non-empty when applicable is false — see leading_indicators.py::validate_leading_indicator_thresholds, which fails config loading if this is missing.
